title: Judgement adjustment durable persistence and secondary gameplay consumers

call_chain: SettingsManager.UpdateLiveCoreSettings constructs a replacement immutable LiveCoreSettings snapshot
LiveCoreSettings..ctor copies and normalizes the protobuf fields
generic_save_transaction: CESerializer.Serialize converts the protobuf object to bytes
AESCrypt encrypts the serialized bytes with key 12345678abdegopq, null IV, keySize 128, mode 1 and padding 5
PersistentDataUtility.initDirectory ensures the save directory exists
FileUtility.WriteAllBytes writes the ciphertext with noBackupFlag=true
persistence.file_name_mapping: PersistentDataUtility DataType-to-short-name dictionary; runtime-confirmed by decrypting settings/lcs as CE.LiveCoreSettingsProtoData
persistence.option_save_tail: After the four SettingsManager updates, OptionData.Save separately saves InAppCacheData through SaveInAppCacheData (DataType 3); the 0x32CE120 tail is not the LiveCore save call.

direct.behavior: B=0 returns the current music score position; positive B advances by B engine-frame score steps; negative B rewinds by abs(B) steps. Both directions cross BPM-change boundaries using the active tempo segment.
selects and writes the Slide virtual-perfect entry at baseIndex - JudgementAdjustValueB when the shifted index is inside the list
when JudgementAdjustValueB >= 1, a successful intermediate Slide release result is replaced with NoteResultType.Perfect (4) before submission
negative B delays automatic Stop/miss processing until the counter reaches 6 - B; nonnegative B has no corresponding delay

transitive_entrypoints: NoteManager.ExecAwakeEnd initializes SlideNoteManager and therefore reaches setupJudgeDictionary
SlideNoteManager.Init calls setupJudgeDictionary for the base BPM and every BPM-change group
NoteManager.ReturnTime uses GetAdjustMusicPos while rebuilding time-dependent note state
NoteManager.ExecUpdate dispatches note updates but contains no independent B formula
NoteManager.playNoteGroupInformationList and GetPsylliumSpeed contain no direct B read
secondary_consumers.false_positive_rule: A raw +0x17C search also hits unrelated tutorial and UI classes; only accesses whose base object is InGameCalculatedData are counted.

confirmed: The primary and secondary judgement values are durably saved as part of the LiveCoreSettings protobuf transaction.
The generic save path serializes, AES-encrypts, ensures the directory, and writes ciphertext with the no-backup flag.
PersistentDataUtility initializes SAVE_PATH as Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, settings), and its DataType mapping resolves LiveCoreSettings (5) to the short file name lcs.
Positive and negative B values move the sampled score position in opposite directions rather than changing a single judgement-window constant.
Positive B also has a Slide-specific release-result route that forces Perfect.
Negative B has a separate Slide Stop automatic-miss delay.
inference: The backend-neutral prototype represents the tempo-aware native position loop through caller-supplied one-frame forward and backward stepping functions.
unresolved: No claim is made that a runtime file was modified or observed; this pass is static and read-only.
